dataset_name: Intel RealSense D455 Multi-Session (recording_01 vs recording_02)

confusion_matrix.notes: Empirical predictions evaluated strictly against ground truth without GT access during prediction. Recovered 3/5 relocated objects; 0 false alarms on static objects (FP=0). Missed 2 transient/mobile entities not tracked as persistent static map nodes.

arm_c0_keep.description: Retain all observations in single static nodes without lifecycle split.
arm_c0_keep.notes: Simulated anchor corruption assumes relocated objects were erroneously retained in the anchor pool.

arm_c3_graph_mark_suspect.description: Inflate spatial covariance for predicted relocated instances; exclude from rigid anchor alignment.

arm_c4_graph_temporary_exclude.description: Exclude predicted relocated nodes from active reference map until re-observed.

arm_relocate_split.description: Bifurcate verified relocated entities into historical anchor and active session pose with displacement edge.
arm_relocate_split.notes: Predicted displacements compared against physical laser/tape ground-truth measurements.

arm_reactivate.description: Re-anchor bifurcated entity in current session reference frame.

arm_c5_landmark_downweight.reason: Native ORB-SLAM3 landmark-level downweighting is not exposed via executable interface.

arm_c6_landmark_temporary_exclude.reason: Native ORB-SLAM3 landmark-level exclusion is not exposed via executable interface.

arm_c7_dual_integration.reason: Coordinated scene-graph and native SLAM landmark joint optimization requires C++ core redesign.

zero_fabrication_contract.reason: Handheld D455 captures lack external optical motion-capture ground truth; trajectory ATE strictly null.
